mechanism_narrative: A continued drop in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT reduces downtown trip chaining and discretionary shopping trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks as fewer people combine work and shopping errands.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior four weeks even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below their recent averages for the full next month.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls below the -15% baseline and remains there, access to retail districts deteriorates enough to cut retail visits within one to two weeks, so RETAIL_REC declines further.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -15% and stays there for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stabilizes after TRANSIT crosses and holds below -15% for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GROCERY_PHARM diverts short local shopping demand away from retail and recreation venues, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the next four weeks when essential errands substitute for discretionary outings.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases despite GROCERY_PHARM staying elevated relative to the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises while WORKPLACES falls, people substitute home-based time for shopping trips, and RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks as discretionary outings compress.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline even though RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline and WORKPLACES stays below baseline for most of the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp negative PARKS shock signals adverse weather or seasonal deterrence that also suppresses casual shopping traffic, so RETAIL_REC falls within one week after PARKS drops below recent levels.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not drop within one week of a PARKS decline larger than 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES both stay depressed, the same underlying reduction in out-of-home activity spills into retail visits, causing RETAIL_REC to remain lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rebounds within two weeks while both GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES remain below their recent means.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, improving TRANSIT together with rising WORKPLACES rebuilds city-center access and lunch-hour demand, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over four weeks despite simultaneous recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL is above baseline for two straight weeks, local-at-home substitution is strong enough to keep retail outings suppressed, so RETAIL_REC remains lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above 0 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises after RESIDENTIAL remains positive for two consecutive weeks.
